🛠️ SAP Approved AI Tools for PMM

What they are, why you'd use them, and how to get started

Data & Analytics Product Marketing • May 2026

These tools are approved for use by SAP employees. Tier 1 tools are enterprise-provided and available now. Tier 2 tools are licensed and approved for business use. No additional procurement needed — just start using them!

Tier 1: Enterprise-Provided (Available Now)
These tools are provided by SAP IT and ready to use with your SAP credentials.
Microsoft Copilot Chat
Your AI assistant for everyday work
What It Is
A conversational AI assistant integrated into your Microsoft 365 environment. Think of it as ChatGPT, but secured for enterprise use and connected to Microsoft's ecosystem.
Why You'd Use It
Quick answers to questions, brainstorming ideas, drafting emails, summarizing content, and getting help with everyday tasks — all within a secure, approved environment.
▶ Get Started
Visit copilot.microsoft.com and sign in with your SAP credentials.
SAP GenAI Experience Lab
SAP's internal AI playground with PPT generator
What It Is
SAP's internal generative AI platform featuring multiple AI models and specialized tools — including a PowerPoint generator that creates presentation drafts from prompts.
Why You'd Use It
Creating first-draft presentations, experimenting with different AI models, and building AI-powered prototypes in a fully SAP-supported environment.
▶ Get Started
Access via SAP internal portal. Search "GenAI Experience Lab" on SAP One.
CompeteGPT
AI-powered competitive intelligence
What It Is
SAP's competitive intelligence AI assistant that can answer questions about competitors, market positioning, and competitive dynamics using curated competitive data.
Why You'd Use It
Quick competitive research, preparing for customer conversations, understanding competitor positioning, and getting up to speed on competitive landscapes.
▶ Get Started
Access via SAP CI Portal or search "CompeteGPT" on SAP One.
EKX (Enterprise Knowledge Exchange)
Ask questions across SAP's knowledge base
What It Is
An AI-powered search and Q&A system that can find and synthesize information from across SAP's internal knowledge bases, documents, and resources.
Why You'd Use It
Finding internal documentation, understanding SAP products and processes, locating subject matter experts, and getting answers from institutional knowledge.
▶ Get Started
Visit ekx.sap.com with your SAP credentials.
Joule
SAP's AI copilot across applications
What It Is
SAP's native AI assistant embedded across SAP applications. It understands business context and can help with tasks directly within SAP systems.
Why You'd Use It
Getting help within SAP applications, automating routine tasks, understanding data and reports, and navigating SAP systems more efficiently.
▶ Get Started
Look for the Joule icon (✨) in SAP applications. Available in SuccessFactors, S/4HANA, and more.
Claude Code (via Anthropic)
AI coding assistant for technical work
What It Is
An AI assistant specialized for coding, technical writing, and complex analysis. Known for nuanced understanding and ability to handle long, detailed documents.
Why You'd Use It
Technical documentation, code review, analyzing complex data, creating detailed frameworks, and tasks requiring careful reasoning.
▶ Get Started
Access via SAP-approved channel. Check with your manager for access details.
Tier 2: Licensed & Approved for Use
These tools are approved for business use. Some require individual licenses; check with your manager about budget.
Perplexity Pro
Research assistant with real-time web access
What It Is
An AI research tool that searches the web in real-time and provides answers with citations. Unlike ChatGPT, it always shows its sources.
Why You'd Use It
Competitive research, market analysis, fact-checking, finding recent news, and any research where you need to verify sources and cite your work.
▶ Get Started
Visit perplexity.ai. Free tier available; Pro is $20/month for advanced features.
Canva
Design tool with AI-powered features
What It Is
A visual design platform with AI features including Magic Design, background removal, text-to-image, and smart resize. Makes professional graphics accessible to non-designers.
Why You'd Use It
Social media graphics, presentation visuals, infographics, event materials, and quick visual content when you don't have time to wait for design team support.
▶ Get Started
Visit canva.com. Pro licenses available via Ariba Guided Buying (€149/year).
Synthesia
AI video generation with avatars
What It Is
A platform that creates professional videos using AI avatars. You provide a script, it generates a video with a realistic AI presenter — no filming required.
Why You'd Use It
Training videos, product explainers, internal communications, and any video content where you need professional quality without the production overhead.
▶ Get Started
Visit synthesia.io. Check with your manager for team license access.
Claude (Anthropic)
Thoughtful AI for complex tasks
What It Is
An AI assistant known for nuanced, thoughtful responses. Excels at long-form content, careful analysis, and tasks requiring attention to detail.
Why You'd Use It
Long-form writing, document analysis, strategic thinking, editing and refinement, and any task where quality matters more than speed.
▶ Get Started
Visit claude.ai. Free tier available; Pro is $20/month.
ChatGPT (OpenAI)
The original general-purpose AI assistant
What It Is
OpenAI's flagship AI assistant. Fast, versatile, and capable across a wide range of tasks from writing to coding to analysis.
Why You'd Use It
Quick drafts, brainstorming, code help, data analysis, and general-purpose AI assistance when you need fast, good-enough results.
▶ Get Started
Visit chat.openai.com. Free tier available; Plus is $20/month.
Copilot in Word/PowerPoint/Teams
AI embedded in your daily tools
What It Is
Microsoft Copilot integrated directly into Office apps. Draft documents in Word, create presentations in PowerPoint, summarize meetings in Teams.
Why You'd Use It
Document drafting, presentation creation, meeting summaries, email composition — AI help right where you're already working.
▶ Get Started
Look for the Copilot icon in Word, PowerPoint, and Teams. Requires M365 Copilot license.

Questions? Contact the D&A PMM team or visit futureofpmm.com/ai-tools-guide.html
